svg.title: Street width-to-height ratio
svg.desc: Three sections: height 12 metres in every example, facade widths 12, 24 and 36 metres; width/height 1, 2 and 3. Source claims: section-ratio. Nominal building-strip width 3 m follows the original illustration. Longitudinal prism extent 16 m (8 m retained behind the cut), scale-context placement, diagram-row separation and base relief are illustrative. Trees 5 m, people 1.75 m and car body 5 × 1.8 m provide illustrative scale. No metre storey heights or floor counts are inferred.
